## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "orbit-view", "name": "orbit-view", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "view"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:x`, or read elsewhere as `ch('orbit-view/x')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->
